article_content: By Helen Pow. PUBLISHED: 17:07 EST, 16 June 2013 | UPDATED: 19:54 EST, 16 June 2013 Sometimes horsing around can be the best therapy. An Illinois non-profit is training miniature horses as therapy animals, bringing them to nursing homes, schools, hospitals, and veteran facilities where they provide comfort to disabled people or those who have suffered trauma. The adorable horses, the size of a golden retriever, are petted, brushed, hugged, and loved by the people they visit, improving their physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Jodie Diegel, founder of Mane in Heaven, approaches Lunar, the oldest mare of the group, in a wheelchair to desensitize the horse at Dynasty Farm in Lake in the Hills, Illinois. The horses visit nursing homes, schools, hospitals, and veteran facilities to provide comfort and affection to those in need. Diegel founded Mane in Heaven with her four horses: Lunar, Turnabout, Mystery, and Jenella. The animals wear tiny rubber-soled shoes made for stuffed toy bears when they go to work. 'It's the same reaction everybody has when they first see the animals,' she says. 'The first three words to come out of their mouths are, 'Oh my gosh!' The size of the horses is unexpected, and the fact that they are wearing sneakers and a halter with their name written in crystal 'bling' across the nose always gets a reaction. 'Aside from looking very cute, they actually provide a functional purpose,' Diegel explains about the little round shoes. Diegel, her four board members, and the three eldest miniature horses have all passed the evaluation process of Pet Partners, a national organization that determines whether animals and handlers are ready for visits to places such as hospitals, nursing homes, and schools. 'We're founded with the mission to train them as therapy animals,' Diegel says, adding that miniature horses are now also being used as guides for vision-impaired persons. 'What's really exciting is to see my vision and my mission coming to life with these miniature horses.' She and 43 committed volunteers meet every weekend at Dynasty Farm in Lake in the Hills, where the 'minis' are boarded. There, volunteers get to know the horses and train to be handlers. Part of the training includes desensitizing the horses so they ignore the natural impulse to flee from danger, like that presented by a rolling wheelchair. The horses are taught to behave in a variety of settings. Diegel laughs and admits that sometimes it's easier to train the horses than the people. 'They are absolutely amazing little animals,' she laughs. 'But I am totally amazed at the commitment and ability of our volunteers. It's a joy to watch the interaction.'

article_content: (CNN) -- Swedish golfer Richard S. Johnson claimed his second European Tour title after sinking a monster putt to avoid a playoff at his home Scandinavian Masters on Sunday. The U.S.-based 33-year-old drained a 30-foot birdie effort at the final hole to end the hopes of Argentina's Rafa Echenique and follow up his 2002 victory in a co-sanctioned Australian event, which was not part of the European Tour. Johnson went into the tournament without his regular caddy Lance Ten Broeck, who played in a different tournament instead, so his friend Anders Timmell -- a Stockholm radio DJ -- carried his bags instead. While Ten Broeck missed the cut at Carnoustie in Scotland, Johnson carded a final-round one-under-par 71 to finish on 11-under 277 at Bro Hof Slott. 'It's one of the sweetest things I've ever done. Just to come up the 17th and 18th is magical,' the world No. 329 told the European Tour website. 'This is a huge tournament to win for a Swede and I'm speechless right now. It's epic.' World No. 371 Echenique closed with a 69 to be one shot back, while Italy's Edoardo Molinari claimed third place with the same score after a 20-foot closing putt lifted him above a group on 280 which included British Open champion Louis Oosthuizen. Joint first-round leader Oosthuizen tied with Australia's Brett Rumford (69) and New Zealander Mark Brown (71) following his 73. 'I didn't play well. I didn't drive well and it put everything under pressure. I had to push it at the end, but Richard played brilliantly,' the South African said. 'I'm a bit disappointed, but after last week I was hoping to make the cut and I finished fourth, so I'm happy.' Johnson went into the final round sharing the lead with K.J. Choi, but the veteran Korean collapsed with a 78 to finish back in 13th on 284. Meanwhile, Germany's Bernhard Langer claimed his first major title on the seniors circuit with a one-shot victory at the British Senior Open on Sunday. The 52-year-old finished one shot clear of U.S. Ryder Cup captain Corey Pavin after his closing one-over 72 gave him a total of five-under 279. Pavin, 50, playing in his first seniors major, shot 70 as he was unable to peg back the former European Ryder Cup leader's three-shot overnight lead. At the women's Evian Masters event in France, world No. 4 Jiyai Shin snatched a one-shot victory with a birdie at the final hole. The 22-year-old is expected to return to the top of the women's golf rankings after her closing five-under 67 made her the first South Korean to win the tournament, which is sanctioned by both the European and LPGA Tours. She finished on 14-under 274 ahead of fellow Korean Na Yeon Choi (66), overnight leader Morgan Pressel (70), and another American Alexis Thompson (67). Shin recently returned to action following an emergency appendectomy six weeks ago. At the Canadian Open in Toronto, Dean Wilson took a four-shot lead into Sunday's final round of the PGA Tour event after shooting his third successive five-under 65. The 40-year-old, playing on a sponsor's exemption due to his past performances, will be chased by the second-placed group of Carl Pettersson, Tim Clark and Bob Estes. Sweden's Pettersson earlier broke the tournament record with a 10-under 60 at St. George's as he just missed out on the magical 59 mark when his final putt from 30 feet went just wide of the hole.
translated_content: (CNN) -- 瑞典高尔夫球手理查德·S·约翰逊在周日的斯堪的纳维亚大师赛上避开加洞赛，成功赢得了他的第二个欧洲巡回赛冠军头衔。这位33岁的美国球手在最后一洞成功进球，结束了阿根廷选手拉法·埃切尼克的希望，并追平了他在2002年联合认可的澳大利亚赛事中的胜利，但该赛事不属于欧洲巡回赛。约翰逊在没有他的常规球童兰斯·滕·布罗克的情况下参加了比赛，兰斯参加了另一场比赛，所以他的朋友安德斯·蒂梅尔——一位斯德哥尔摩的电台DJ——替他背球包。尽管滕·布罗克在苏格兰的卡努斯蒂未能晋级，约翰逊还是以低于标准杆1杆的71杆完成了最后一轮，以低于标准杆11杆的277杆在布罗霍夫斯洛特结束比赛。“这是我做过的最甜蜜的事情之一。能够打到17号洞和18号洞真是太神奇了。”世界排名第329位的他对欧洲巡回赛网站说。“这是一个瑞典人能赢得的巨大赛事，我现在无话可说。这真是史诗般的。”世界排名第371位的埃切尼克以69杆结束比赛，落后一杆，而意大利的埃多阿多·莫里纳利以同样的成绩获得第三名，他在最后一洞的20英尺推杆使他超越了280杆的一组球员，其中包括英国公开赛冠军路易斯·乌修森。首轮并列领先的乌修森在73杆之后与澳大利亚的布雷特·伦弗德（69杆）和新西兰的马克·布朗（71杆）并列。“我打得不好。我开球不好，这让一切都压力重重。我不得不在最后阶段拼命追赶，但理查德打得非常出色。”南非人说。“我有点失望，但在上周之后，我希望能晋级，我排名第四，所以我很高兴。”约翰逊在最后一轮与韩国老将崔京周并列领先，但崔京周以78杆崩溃，最终以284杆排名第13位。与此同时，德国的伯恩哈德·兰格在周日的英国公开赛上以一杆优势赢得了他的第一个资深巡回赛大满贯冠军。这位52岁的球手在他的最后一轮72杆之后，以低于标准杆5杆的279杆，领先美国莱德杯队长科里·帕文一杆。帕文在他的首次资深大满贯比赛中打出70杆，未能追回前欧洲莱德杯队长三杆的夜间领先优势。在法国的女子依云锦标赛上，世界排名第4的智英申在最后一洞成功抓鸟，以一杆优势获胜。这位22岁的球手在她的最后一轮五低于标准杆的67杆之后，成为首位赢得该赛事的韩国人，该赛事由欧洲巡回赛和LPGA巡回赛联合认可。她以低于标准杆14杆的274杆领先于同胞李志勋（66杆）、夜间领先者摩根·普雷塞尔（70杆）和另一位美国选手亚历克西斯·汤普森（67杆）。申智英最近在六周前进行了紧急阑尾切除手术后重返赛场。在多伦多的加拿大公开赛上，迪安·威尔逊在周日的PGA巡回赛最后一轮以四杆优势进入比赛，他连续三轮打出低于标准杆5杆的65杆。这位40岁的球手凭借赞助商的外卡参赛，他将被卡尔·彼得森、蒂姆·克拉克和鲍勃·埃斯特斯组成的第二名小组追赶。瑞典的彼得森早些时候在圣乔治打出低于标准杆10杆的60杆，打破了赛事纪录，但他在最后一洞的30英尺推杆偏出，错失了神奇的59杆。

article_content: When Andres Escobar's family steps onto the field wearing his iconic No. 2 jersey this Friday, they will evoke deep emotions among millions of Colombians watching from home. The national team, known as Los Cafeteros, has reached the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time, and the entire country will come to a standstill as they take on the formidable Brazilian team. Yet, it is the haunting CCTV footage of Escobar, who was tragically shot after a dispute over his own goal during the 1994 World Cup, that has galvanized Jose Pekerman's squad. The vivid memory of Escobar, captured in grainy images, serves as a poignant reminder of the blend of vibrant football and the shadowy underworld of drug cartels and gang violence that characterizes Colombian football. Even the current star, James Rodriguez, who leads the World Cup in goals scored, began his career at Envigado, a club near Medellin with a troubled past. Eight years ago, the club's owner, Gustavo Upequi, a key figure in Rodriguez's early career, was murdered. Colombia is now striving to shed its dark history and showcase its exceptional football talent to the world. President Juan Manuel Santos will attend the match, having declared a half-day holiday for the nation's 48 million people. English football also shares a connection with Colombia's past, from Rene Higuita's famous scorpion kick to the memorable performances of Faustino Asprilla and Carlos Valderrama. Pekerman's team breezed through the group stages, with Rodriguez playing a pivotal role in their victory over Uruguay. Valderrama, often considered the greatest Colombian footballer, believes that Rodriguez, at just 22, has the potential to become the country's most celebrated player. The Monaco forward has been a standout performer, scoring crucial goals against Greece, Ivory Coast, Japan, and twice against Uruguay. 'El Pipe is our football legend, and I wear the No. 10 shirt with immense pride,' Rodriguez said. 'To have him speak highly of me is an honor. Carlos was one of the greatest, and if I can achieve even a fraction of what he did, I will be extremely happy.' The stadium will be packed, and a victory over Brazil, which hasn't happened since a 2-0 win in the 1991 Copa America, would be monumental. This new generation of players, including Rodriguez, Jackson Martinez, and Mario Yepes, aims to surpass the achievements of the past. 'Our coach has united us, and we are fighting for each other and for Colombia,' Rodriguez stated. 'It's encouraging to hear positive feedback, but I stay grounded and focused on improving.' So far, Rodriguez and his teammates are on the right track, inspiring hope and pride in their nation.
translated_content: 当安德烈斯·埃斯科巴的家人本周五身穿他那标志性的2号球衣走上球场时，他们将唤起数百万在家观看比赛的哥伦比亚人的深刻情感。被称为洛斯卡费特罗斯的国家队首次打入世界杯八强，全国将为之驻足，观看他们与强大的巴西队一决高下。 然而，正是埃斯科巴在1994年世界杯因乌龙球引发争执后被枪杀的模糊监控画面，激励了何塞·佩克尔曼的球队。埃斯科巴的生动记忆，通过粗糙的图像捕捉到，成为哥伦比亚足球特征——色彩斑斓与毒品卡特尔和黑帮暴力交织的阴暗世界——的一个鲜明提醒。 即使是当前的明星球员詹姆斯·罗德里格斯，他在本届世界杯上进球最多，也是从麦德林附近的恩维加多俱乐部开始他的职业生涯，而这家俱乐部有着不光彩的历史。八年前，俱乐部老板古斯塔沃·乌佩基，罗德里格斯职业生涯早期的重要人物，被谋杀。 如今，哥伦比亚正努力摆脱其黑暗历史，向世界展示其卓越的足球天赋。总统胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯将出席比赛，并为全国4800万人宣布半天假期。英格兰足球也与哥伦比亚的过去有着联系，从雷内·伊基塔的著名蝎子摆尾到福斯蒂诺·阿斯普里拉和卡洛斯·巴尔德拉马的难忘表现。 佩克尔曼的球队轻松通过小组赛，罗德里格斯在对阵乌拉圭的比赛中发挥了关键作用。常被认为是最伟大的哥伦比亚球员的巴尔德拉马相信，年仅22岁的罗德里格斯有潜力成为国家最受欢迎的球员。摩纳哥前锋表现出色，在对阵希腊、科特迪瓦、日本以及两次对阵乌拉圭的比赛中攻入关键球。 '埃尔皮普是我们的足球传奇，我以极大的自豪穿上他的10号球衣，'罗德里格斯说。'听到他对我的赞美是一种荣幸。卡洛斯是最伟大的球员之一，如果我能取得他成就的一小部分，我会非常高兴。' 体育场将座无虚席，战胜巴西队——自1991年美洲杯以来还未发生过——将是一个重大突破。这一代球员，包括罗德里格斯、杰克逊·马丁内斯和马里奥·耶佩斯，旨在超越过去的成就。'我们的教练团结了我们，我们为彼此和为哥伦比亚而战，'罗德里格斯说。'听到积极的反馈是鼓舞人心的，但我保持谦逊，专注于提升自己。' 到目前为止，罗德里格斯和他的队友们正走在正确的道路上，激发着国家的希望和自豪。

article_content: Known affectionately as the ‘happy slam’, the Australian Open is set to become even bigger and more magical this year, thanks to a touch of Disney enchantment. Tennis Australia has ambitious plans to expand the tournament site in Melbourne, stretching all the way to Federation Square. This multi-million dollar project aims to outshine rival grand slams like Wimbledon, the French Open, and the US Open. But that’s just the start. According to the Herald Sun, Tennis Australia is also seeking approval from Melbourne City Council to create an expansive entertainment zone. This zone will extend from Federation Square along the Yarra River, past Birrarung Marr Park, to Batman Avenue. The revamped site will feature a new bridge connecting Melbourne’s CBD to the sporting precinct, with Rod Laver Arena remaining the centerpiece. This year, Disney will bring its magic to the Australian Open, transforming the Hisense Arena into a mini-Disneyland during the tournament’s final week. Movies like Frozen, Big Hero 6, and The Lion King will be screened, adding to the family-friendly atmosphere. Popular player Eugenie Bouchard, a favorite among teenage fans, is expected to draw significant crowds, further enhancing the event’s appeal to younger audiences. The new entertainment zone will be temporary, set up annually during the tournament. A proposed $348 million upgrade includes a pedestrian bridge to facilitate easy access. ‘The bridge will create a clear pedestrian route from Melbourne Park to the city center, allowing for entertainment facilities to be incorporated,’ said a spokesperson for Major Projects Victoria. The zone will be free to the public and offer various attractions such as live music, gourmet dining, children’s play areas, and bars. Tennis Australia has initiated discussions with the local council and hopes for approval by the 2016 tournament. ‘Our vision is to amplify the existing entertainment and make it more accessible,’ said Richard Heaselgrave, TA’s commercial director. Heaselgrave also revealed plans to extend the tournament from two to three weeks, aligning with the goals of Lord Mayor Robert Doyle. ‘The Australian Open is more than just tennis; it’s an entertainment festival,’ he emphasized. The event aims to break attendance records this year, targeting 700,000 spectators over the next two weeks, weather permitting.
translated_content: 被亲切地称为‘快乐大满贯’的澳大利亚网球公开赛今年将变得更加庞大和神奇，这要归功于迪士尼的魔法。澳大利亚网球协会有着雄心勃勃的计划，将墨尔本的赛事场地扩展到联邦广场。这个价值数百万美元的项目旨在超越温布尔登网球公开赛、法国网球公开赛和美国网球公开赛等竞争对手。 但这只是个开始。根据《先驱太阳报》报道，澳大利亚网球协会还在寻求墨尔本市政府的批准，创建一个庞大的娱乐区。这个娱乐区将从联邦广场沿着雅拉河，经过比拉朗马尔公园，到达巴特曼大道。改造后的场地将包括一座新桥，连接墨尔本中央商务区和体育场，罗德拉沃尔球场仍然是中心。 今年，迪士尼将把它的魔法带到澳大利亚网球公开赛，在比赛的最后一周将海信球场变成一个迷你迪士尼乐园。电影如《冰雪奇缘》、《大英雄6》和《狮子王》将上映，增加家庭友好的氛围。受青少年粉丝喜爱的著名球员尤金妮·布沙尔预计将吸引大量观众，进一步增强赛事对年轻观众的吸引力。 新的娱乐区将是临时的，每年在赛事期间设置。提议的3.48亿美元升级计划包括一座人行天桥，以便于访问。‘这座桥将创建一条从墨尔本公园到市中心的明确步行路线，允许在此处设置娱乐设施，’维多利亚重大项目发言人说。 该区域将免费向公众开放，并提供各种娱乐设施，如现场音乐、美食、儿童游乐区和酒吧。澳大利亚网球协会已经与当地政府展开讨论，并希望在2016年赛事前获得批准。‘我们的愿景是放大现有的娱乐设施，使其更易于访问，’TA商业总监理查德·希斯尔格雷夫说。 希斯尔格雷夫还透露，计划将赛事从两周延长到三周，与市长罗伯特·多伊尔的目标一致。‘澳大利亚网球公开赛不仅仅是网球；它是一个娱乐节，’他强调。该活动今年计划打破观众纪录，目标是在未来两周内吸引70万观众，如果天气允许的话。

article_content: By Simeon Gholam. Follow @SimGholam. Luka Modric has revealed that Roma legend Francesco Totti is his footballing idol. article_content: The profile photo of Abu Layth, also known as 20-year-old Anil Khalil Raoufi, on Twitter reveals a stark transformation. Just a few years ago, he was a typical Western teenager with a passion for cars and aspirations to become a mechanic. However, yesterday, former university student Anil Khalil Raoufi was identified as the latest Briton to be killed while fighting with Islamist extremists in Syria. Neighbors describe how the once 'friendly' teenager, who dreamt of becoming a mechanic, underwent a dramatic radicalization. He dropped out of his mechanical engineering course at Liverpool University, adopted full Islamic dress, and even stopped interacting with non-Muslim friends. Raoufi's actions reportedly stunned his family, who lived in an affluent Manchester suburb where his father ran a restaurant business. One source claimed his family was unaware of his travels to Syria, let alone his death. Yesterday, anti-terrorist police conducted a search of his family's home after Raoufi was revealed to be the fighter known as Abu Layth. The 20-year-old was considered a key figure in recruiting Britons to fight for Al Qaeda-linked militant groups in Syria until his recent death. Under the Twitter handle 'Abu Layth,' he shared graphic accounts of Syria's brutal civil war, even likening a firefight to a scene from 'Star Wars.' In one post, he described al-Qaeda as 'a beautiful thing.' Counter-terrorist police searched his family's house in the affluent Manchester suburb of Didsbury. The second oldest of four children, Raoufi was a keen amateur boxer who had recently turned 20. He had an older brother, Naveed, a pharmacist in Manchester, a sister, Naveeda, 22, and a younger brother. The family's £250,000 three-bedroom semi-detached house is close to two restaurants owned by his father. A local resident described his mother, Kamala, as 'a lovely, lovely woman, completely part of the street's life.' Neighbors noted that around the age of 17, Raoufi shifted from being a popular high school student with many non-Muslim friends and a car enthusiast to an Islamist radical. He began wearing traditional Islamic clothing, grew a beard, and became distant. Workers at the nearby Didsbury Mosque said he was not well-known there, and he is believed to have been recruited to join the jihad in Syria through online contacts with committed Islamists. He traveled to Syria to join another Briton, Iftikhar Jaman, a 23-year-old call center worker from Portsmouth who was also killed fighting with the rebels. Raoufi joined the Islamic State of Iraq and al-Sham, a militant group known for its atrocities, and is believed to have led a brigade of British fighters. He was reportedly shot in the head during a clash with a rival rebel group earlier this month. Terrorism expert Neil Doyle stated, 'He was one of the most visible British fighters in Syria and seems to have played a key role in recruiting fellow Islamists.' Former school friends expressed shock and posted tributes online. One friend, Naomi Stark, wrote, 'RIP Anil, you were always so funny and friendly in high school.' Another Twitter user, 'Marvi,' wrote, 'Upsetting hearing about Anil, he was a real soldier, he did what most of us could not imagine doing. Died whilst protecting others.' Detective Chief Inspector Will Chatterton of the North West Counter-Terrorism Unit said his officers were providing support to the family and urged anyone with information about Britons traveling to Syria to contact the police.

article_content: In a shocking incident captured on camera, a young mother was seen walking her two children across a bustling railway line in Pitsea, Essex, seemingly to take a shortcut. She pushed one child in a stroller along the tracks while a toddler trailed behind, perilously close to where trains frequently pass. The British Transport Police (BTP), currently seeking the woman, have shared CCTV footage to underscore the grave risks of trespassing on railway property. A BTP spokesperson commented, 'We aren’t sure of her motives, but the likely reason for crossing the railway with two small children appears to be taking a shortcut. People often fail to realize that traversing train tracks is as hazardous as walking down a busy motorway.' This event follows numerous warnings from police about the escalating trend of youths trespassing on railways, endangering both their own lives and those of passengers. To combat this alarming issue, BTP has initiated Operation Intruder, aiming to curb these incidents. Recent examples include a 16-year-old boy who suffered severe burns in Rugby, Warwickshire, after contacting overhead power lines, and a group of children in Ilkeston, Derbyshire, who placed a concrete block on the tracks, causing a train collision. In Essex, police were alerted to three children lingering on a railway crossing at Westcliffe-on-Sea, further highlighting the urgent need for increased safety measures and public awareness.

article_content: A young dental nurse, Bernadette Lee, tragically passed away from hypothermia after being locked out in freezing weather following a night out. Bernadette, 25, was discovered lifeless in the snow near her sister Jodie's residence on January 19. She was dressed in a short dress without a coat and had removed her shoes. An inquest revealed that Bernadette had planned to stay with a friend but got separated from them. She then headed to her sister's house, unaware that Jodie had lost her keys and was staying elsewhere, leaving no one to let her in. Bernadette's mobile phone records showed she made 27 desperate calls in her final hours, trying to reach friends, but the calls stopped at 3:51 am. A Kent Police report stated that Bernadette had been drinking at a friend's house and later went to a nightclub. She intended to stay at her friend Cheryl Coley's place but got separated from the group. At 2:30 am, she got a ride with three others to Middle Deal Road in Deal, Kent. They entered a house without her while Bernadette tried to contact Cheryl. The inquest heard that between 1:54 am and 3:17 am, Bernadette called Cheryl four times, but Cheryl was preoccupied with a personal issue. Bernadette also attempted to reach her father Roger, whose phone was off, and several other friends. Cheryl later told police that Bernadette knew she could come over anytime. As temperatures dropped to -2°C, Bernadette lay down in the snow and succumbed to hypothermia. Her body was found by a dog walker at 7:50 am on a lawn in Deal, Kent. The dog walker initially mistook her for a mannequin before realizing it was a body. He noticed she wasn't wearing a coat, only a dress, and saw a mobile phone nearby. He checked her pulse, thinking she might be asleep, before calling emergency services. The North East Kent coroner reported that Bernadette had high alcohol levels, increasing her risk of hypothermia. A post-mortem found no signs of violence or injury. After the inquest, Bernadette's family from Canterbury, Kent, expressed their grief, stating that her death could have been easily prevented. They urged partygoers to be cautious in cold weather. Roger Lee, 63, and Jodie said, 'We hate the thought of other families going through such a harrowing ordeal. Please don't put yourself in a situation where you are totally dependent on someone else. Always take a coat in the winter as plans can change. If you arrange for someone to stay with you, be responsible as their lives could depend on you.' Jodie added, 'My sister Bernie was such a lovely girl and she didn't deserve to die like this.' Roger Lee said, 'I'm devastated. My life will never be the same again. I brought her up by myself and we were very close. We could speak for hours on the phone. She was a beautiful girl and very intelligent. I loved her so much—everybody did. She was a very popular girl, a lovely girl.' Bernadette's friend mentioned she had consumed a lot of alcohol and was wearing a dress without a coat, typical of her desire to look good when going out. The inquest concluded that Bernadette died from hypothermia and alcohol intoxication. Coroner Rebecca Cobb recorded a verdict of misadventure, explaining, 'That is similar to an accident but means there were aspects of her behavior that contributed to her death, like the alcohol she had consumed.'
translated_content: 一位年轻的牙科护士伯纳黛特·李在外出后因被锁在冰冷的天气中不幸冻死。伯纳黛特，25岁，于1月19日被发现倒在她姐姐乔迪家附近的雪地里，已经没有生命迹象。她穿着短裙，没有穿外套，也脱掉了鞋子。验尸官调查显示，伯纳黛特原本计划和朋友一起过夜，但她们走散了。她随后前往姐姐家，却不知道乔迪丢了钥匙，正住在别处，因此没人能让她进去。 伯纳黛特的手机记录显示，她在最后几个小时内拨打了27个绝望的电话，试图联系朋友，但电话在凌晨3:51停止了。肯特警方的报告称，伯纳黛特当晚在朋友家喝酒，后来去了一家夜总会。她原本打算留在朋友切丽尔·科利的家里，但与团队走散了。凌晨2:30，她和另外三个人搭车到迪尔的中德路，他们进了房子，而伯纳黛特试图联系切丽尔。 调查显示，从凌晨1:54到3:17，伯纳黛特给切丽尔打了四次电话，但切丽尔当时正忙于个人问题。伯纳黛特还试图联系她的父亲罗杰，但他的电话关机，还有其他几个朋友。切丽尔后来告诉警方，伯纳黛特知道她可以随时过来。当气温降到-2°C时，伯纳黛特躺在雪地里死于低体温症。她的尸体在凌晨7:50被一位遛狗的人发现，倒在迪尔的草坪上。 遛狗的人起初以为那是一个假人，随后意识到那是一具尸体。他注意到她没穿外套，只穿了一件连衣裙，并看到附近有一部手机。他检查了她的脉搏，以为她可能在睡觉，然后拨打了紧急服务电话。东北肯特验尸官报告说，伯纳黛特体内酒精含量高，增加了她低体温症的风险。尸检没有发现任何暴力或伤害的迹象。 验尸后，伯纳黛特的家人表达了他们的悲痛，并表示她的死亡原本是可以避免的。他们敦促参加派对的人在寒冷天气中要小心。罗杰·李，63岁，和乔迪说：'我们讨厌其他家庭经历这样的痛苦。请不要让自己陷入完全依赖他人的境地，因为事情可能会出错。冬天一定要带外套，因为计划可能会改变。如果你安排别人留在你这里，请负责任，因为他们的生命可能依赖于你。' 乔迪补充道：'我妹妹伯尼是个很可爱的女孩，她不应该这样死去。'罗杰·李说：'我心碎了。我的生活再也不会像以前一样了。我一个人把她养大，我们非常亲密。我们可以在电话里聊上几个小时。她是个美丽且聪明的女孩。我非常爱她——每个人都爱她。她是个非常受欢迎的女孩，一个可爱的女孩。'伯纳黛特的朋友提到她喝了很多酒，穿着连衣裙没穿外套，这很符合她外出时想要打扮得漂亮的习惯。 调查结论是伯纳黛特死于低体温症和酒精中毒。验尸官雷贝卡·科布记录了意外死亡的裁决，解释说：'这类似于一场事故，但意味着她的行为有些方面导致了她的死亡，比如她喝的酒。'
